description.value:
As part of the action used to cast this power, you may move up to your speed and make one melee weapon attack. A hit deals an extra 1d10 damage of the weapon's type, and forces a Strength save on the target — a failure knocks it prone.

Force Potency. Cast with a force slot of 4th level or higher, the bonus weapon damage increases by 1d10 for every two slot levels above 2nd.
